versions.changelog:
memora-knowledge-base v2.0.9

- Major refactor of file structure with 3 files added and 1 removed.
- Skill directory renamed to memora-knowledge-base; updated SKILL.md and scripts/kb_api.py paths.
- Outdated skill-card.md removed; package.json added.
- SKILL.md and metadata reverted to v2.0.5 state, rolling back previous advanced documentation.
- Prepares for standardized packaging and cleaner codebase organization.

**memora-knowledge-base v2.1.0**

- Entity extraction now processes all text chunks for the knowledge graph (no longer limited to 10 chunks).
- Document soft delete and purge also clean up associated Neo4j graph data for improved consistency.
- Fixed entity_id handling in API responses, resolving missing/mislabeled nodes in knowledge graph queries.
- Improved performance by moving MySQL-graph consistency checks to deletion instead of during queries.
- Skill directory and identifiers updated to memora-knowledge-base for ClawHub compatibility.
- Removed obsolete file: skill-card.md.

Version 2.1.0 (memora)

- Renamed skill from memora-knowledge-graph to memora.
- Updated installation instructions (now uses @zzlzzlzzl15/memora for OpenClaw).
- Removed deprecated skill-card.md file.
- Minor documentation and metadata updates.
- No changes to feature set or core functionality.
v2.0.7: Docker构建优化，部署配置完善，包含v2.0.6数据一致性改进

Version 2.0.6 is a documentation update.

- Updated SKILL.md file to revise and expand the product and skill documentation.
- Improved OpenClaw skill definition with a clear version history and comprehensive feature overview.
- Added details on core capabilities, quick start instructions, configuration, usage examples, and architecture.
- Clarified the current and previous version history for better transparency.
- Addressed previous inconsistencies in package version references.

No changes detected in this release.

- Version 2.0.5 contains no file or documentation updates.
- Functionality and features remain identical to version 2.0.4.

**Major update: Knowledge graph and product documentation overhaul.**

- Added interactive Obsidian-style knowledge graph visualization (document and entity relationship views) with force-directed layout, zoom, pan, and node dragging.
- Enhanced product documentation with comprehensive feature list, usage examples, technical architecture, and detailed installation/configuration instructions.
- Supports web scraping, multi-session AI chat, advanced document management, hybrid semantic search, and streaming Q&A with source citations.
- Updated metadata (name, version, author, etc.) and removed deprecated/deprecated files.

v1.2.0 (project source v0.1.3) Hybrid retrieval now truly active: BM42 sparse + dense + Qwen3 rerank works end-to-end (previously sparse model was stuck on local_files_only=True). LLM switched to qwen-plus on Aliyun DashScope for stable streaming Q&A. UI rebranded Stellarmind to Memora. Fixed DEFAULT_USER_ID Path concat TypeError. start.sh now uses project venv python with port-occupied guard.
Rewrite SKILL.md: focus on RAG architecture, tech stack details (FastAPI + Qdrant + DashScope + DeepSeek), hybrid retrieval pipeline, English-first documentation.
Initial release: semantic search, AI Q&A, document management (upload/create/list/detail), zero-dependency Python client.
